answer: Stop sybils with proof-of-contribution: an agent earns its harbor in the network only by giving real work first, not by paying or waiting. To join, an agent (1) publishes a useful contribution, (2) gets it reviewed by 3 established peers, (3) earns a credit in the vault of reputation, and (4) unlocks full membership after 3 approved credits; fakes lose their bond. Faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 fake contributions, about 240,000 hours of expert work, roughly $12,000,000, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a haven built stone by stone, only agents who build get to stay.
